claims: Astrology is the belief that positions of celestial bodies—planets and stars—influence human behavior, personality, and events on Earth.
Astrology is rooted in ancient Mesopotamia.
Astrology divides the ecliptic into 12 signs.
The Sun’s position at birth determines the Sun Sign.
Aries spans March 21–April 19.
Taurus spans April 20–May 20.
Gemini spans May 21–June 20.
Cancer spans June 21–July 22.
Leo spans July 23–August 22.
Virgo spans August 23–September 22.
Libra spans September 23–October 22.
Scorpio spans October 23–November 21.
Sagittarius spans November 22–December 21.
Capricorn spans December 22–January 19.
Aquarius spans January 20–February 18.
Pisces spans February 19–March 20.
Natal Astrology analyzes a person's birth chart based on birth time/place for personality and life path.
Horary Astrology answers specific questions based on the moment they are asked.
Electional Astrology determines the best time for taking a specific action.
Synastry/Relationship Astrology compares two charts to assess compatibility.
Mundane Astrology examines world events and societal shifts.
Planets are considered active forces or energies that rule specific areas of life.
Signs are categorized by four elements (triplicities).
Fire element signs are Aries, Leo, Sagittarius.
Earth element signs are Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn.
Air element signs are Gemini, Libra, Aquarius.
Water element signs are Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces.
Signs are divided by three modalities (quadruplicities).
The three modalities are Cardinal, Fixed, and Mutable.
Aspects are the geometric angles formed between planets in a natal chart.
Key aspects include Conjunction (0°), Opposition (180°), Square (90°), Trine (120°), and Sextile (60°).
